26. 從七張分別記有數字 1、2、3、4、5、6 及 7 的紙卡中，隨機同時抽出兩個數字。求抽出數字之積為奇數的概率。

A. 2/7
B. 4/7
C. 12/49
D. 16/49
reasoning: To have an odd product, both numbers drawn must be odd. Among the numbers {1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7}, there are 4 odd numbers (1, 3, 5, 7) and 3 even numbers (2, 4, 6). The total number of ways to choose 2 cards out of 7 is $C_2^7 = 21$. The number of ways to choose 2 odd cards out of 4 is $C_2^4 = 6$. Therefore, the probability is $6/21 = 2/7$.
